description: The account you are authenticated as (linked wallet addresses), plus `localSigners.addresses` — what THIS process holds keys for (any key that could not be read is reported separately under `localSigners.unusable`, and `solanaLink` says whether the Solana wallet held here is proven to the account — an order whose give leg is Solana needs that). Use localSigners.addresses.solana as your settlement address on a Solana leg: the server builds that transaction for whoever the leg names, so naming a key you do not hold makes the leg unsignable.
name: whoami

error.description: Set instead when the call failed

title: Who am I
